verified_facts.text: Hidden Pond sits on 60 acres of birch groves and balsam fir in Kennebunkport, Maine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by 60 acres of birch groves and balsam fir in Kennebunkport, Maine

verified_facts.text: The resort is minutes from Goose Rocks Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: all just minutes from Goose Rocks Beach

verified_facts.text: The resort has two outdoor swimming pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: our private luxury resort features two outdoor swimming pools

verified_facts.text: The Tree Spa is a three-room treetop spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: a three-room treetop spa

verified_facts.text: The Tree Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments and overlooks the birch forest from eight feet above the ground.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from a selection of massages, facials, and body treatments at our peaceful Tree Spa, overlooking the birch forest from eight feet above the ground.

verified_facts.text: The Lodge pool is the family pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Family fun awaits at the Lodge pool

verified_facts.text: The one-bedroom bungalows were created with New York City fashion designer Todd Snyder, each with its own theme inspired by Maine's natural beauty.
verified_facts.excerpt: Created in collaboration with New York City fashion designer Todd Snyder, each features a unique theme inspired by Maine

verified_facts.text: Each one-bedroom bungalow has a stone fireplace, king bed, marble bathroom and an outdoor rain shower framed by forest views.
verified_facts.excerpt: a stone fireplace, plush king bed, marble bathroom, and an outdoor rain shower framed by forest views

verified_facts.text: Todd Snyder designed The From Away Lodge, celebrating Maine's heritage with L.L.Bean upholstery.
verified_facts.excerpt: menswear designer Todd Snyder put his signature touch on The From Away Lodge

verified_facts.text: The From Away Lodge has a signature fragrance created with Kennebunkport's Sea Love Candles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Snyder even partnered with Kennebunkport

verified_facts.text: Each Treetop Lodge combines a studio and a one-bedroom suite, inspired by treehouses and mountainside retreats.
verified_facts.excerpt: each Treetop Lodge is comprised of a studio and a one-bedroom suite, with ample room for up to 5 guests - all inspired by treehouses and mountainside retreats.

verified_facts.text: The two-bedroom cottages have a gourmet kitchen, living room and fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a gourmet kitchen, cozy living room, fireplace, and flat-screen TV

verified_facts.text: Hideaways come with a morning bakery basket delivery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Morning bakery basket delivery

verified_facts.text: Cottages have down-filled duvets and Frette linens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Down-filled duvets and Frette linens

verified_facts.text: Earth at Hidden Pond is the resort's organic restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: organic dining at our award-winning restaurant Earth at Hidden Pond

verified_facts.text: A free shuttle takes guests to lunch at the sister property, The Tides Beach Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Or hop on our free shuttle for lunch at our sister property, The Tides Beach Club.

verified_facts.text: Guests can pick strawberries or tomatoes at the resort's organic garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather a basket of fresh strawberries or sun-ripened tomatoes for a light summer salad at our organic garden

verified_facts.text: A nightly bonfire at the Lodge is set up for s'mores.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids of all ages will delight in the simple pleasure of toasting marshmallows over an open fire each night at the Lodge.

verified_facts.text: Forest bathing is led by certified Forest Therapy Guide Jeanne Christie.
verified_facts.excerpt: Connect to nature through the Japanese-inspired practice of forest bathing, led by certified Forest Therapy Guide, Jeanne Christie.

verified_facts.text: An outdoor slow-flow yoga class is held every morning by the garden, weather permitting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us every morning at 8am for an outdoor, slow flow class by our garden.

verified_facts.text: Guests get a complimentary two-hour kayak or canoe ride launching from downtown Kennebunkport with Kennebunkport Marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a complimentary 2-hour kayak or canoe ride and launch from downtown Kennebunkport with our friends at Kennebunkport Marina.

verified_facts.text: For a beach day the resort provides lounge chairs, towels, water and sunscreen.
verified_facts.excerpt: lounge chairs, towels, water and sunscreen

verified_facts.text: Maine native species from the Center for Wildlife visit the garden on Tuesday afternoons from June through August.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tuesday afternoons June through August in our garden.
